resources.string: Keep your copy with your contacts?

Your copy is sealed with your 24 words and cut into parts. The people you write to keep the parts around a ring, each part with two of them: they see only its size and when it changes, and cannot open it. With your words on a new phone, the parts come back from them, and each of them gives back the conversation you share.
Keep my copy with my contacts
